# Gateway

Set up policies to inspect DNS, Network, HTTP, and Egress traffic

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of pages or to a more detailed `llms.txt` index for a section. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Traffic controls](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/index.md): Filter DNS, network, and HTTP traffic with Cloudflare Gateway traffic policies.

## Get started

- [Get started](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/get-started/index.md): Best practices for deploying Cloudflare Gateway traffic policies in phases.
- [DNS filtering documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/get-started/dns/llms.txt): Secure Web Gateway allows you to inspect DNS traffic and control which websites users can visit.
- [Network filtering](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/get-started/network/index.md): Network filtering in Gateway.
- [HTTP filtering](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/get-started/http/index.md): HTTP filtering in Gateway.

## Integrate Workers

- [Integrate Workers](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/index.md): Run Cloudflare Workers on HTTP traffic permitted by Gateway to transform requests and responses or run background tasks.
- [Forward traffic](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/forward-traffic/index.md): Configure the Gateway Forward action to run a Worker on permitted HTTP requests and responses.
- [Available context](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/available-context/index.md): Reference for the request metadata, identity, and device posture Gateway sends to a Worker invoked by a policy using the Forward action.
- [Worker templates](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/worker-templates/index.md): Small Gateway Worker examples for notifications, capture, watermarking, coaching, and JSON redaction.
- [Send a Slack notification](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/worker-templates/slack-notification/index.md): Send a background Slack notification for a selected Gateway HTTP request.
- [Capture a screenshot](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/worker-templates/screenshot/index.md): Capture a public webpage in an independent browser and save the screenshot to R2 without awaiting it in the user's response.
- [Capture a downloaded file](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/worker-templates/download-capture/index.md): Save a bounded copy of a Gateway-proxied attachment to a private R2 bucket in the background.
- [Watermark HTML pages](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/worker-templates/watermark/index.md): Add a visible user watermark to HTML responses using the Gateway Forward action and HTMLRewriter.
- [Store headers and bodies as JSON](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/worker-templates/json-capture/index.md): Archive selected HTTP headers and bounded JSON request and response bodies in a private R2 bucket.
- [Display a coaching page](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/worker-templates/coaching-page/index.md): Return a custom explanatory HTML page from a Gateway Worker without forwarding the request upstream.
- [Redact a JSON field](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/integrate-workers/worker-templates/json-redaction/index.md): Replace a specific top-level JSON field in a bounded application request before continuing through Gateway.

- [DNS64](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-controls/resolver-endpoints/dns64/index.md): Configure DNS64 synthesis in Cloudflare Gateway using DNS location settings, EDNS options, or DNS over HTTPS headers.
